facts.premium: Small, quiet border economy; modest and highly informal incomes.
facts.skill_gap: Farm, fishing and small-trade labour; very small formal manufacturing (~4.4k factory workers).
impacts: ~82% informal incomes — cash and seasonal, classic title-loan demand.
Smallholder income tracks rubber and palm prices.
Low vehicle stock (~143k) limits per-branch volume.
Lipe/Tarutao tourism adds seasonal cash to coastal districts.
Malaysia trade flows and heavy monsoon rain shape local cash flow.
